reviews.text: Welcoming, Professional, Available
The doctors at the center are attentive, caring, and capable of calming even the most fearful and frightened cats, even with their owners. Excellent center, their helpfulness is extraordinary. Morena

I've known the practice since 2010. I've always had dogs, and I get along very well, both with Elisa, who is always available and very thorough in her work. Michael is very knowledgeable, I trust him a lot, and when a specialist is needed, he knows many doctors to whom I can entrust my pet.

For a second operation for our beloved cat, we once again turned to Veterinaria Settecamini. It goes without saying that we were once again delighted with both the treatment we received and the helpfulness and friendliness of the entire staff. However, we wanted to highlight the skill, professionalism, expertise, and above all the humanity of Dr. Michael LIVOLSI and his support for someone like me who is "anxious" when it comes to furry pets. We also thank the very kind and always smiling ELISA and CAROLA, the empathetic, caring, and sweet Dr. VITTORIA, and the extremely helpful and patient SILVIA, SARA, and FABIANA. Thanks also to Dr. ENRICO, the anesthesiologist, for his initial support, whose kind words made the surgical situation less "burdensome." Our big cat is doing well, we did our best... but SO MUCH credit goes to all these WONDERFUL people! Marcella and Roberto.

We would like to publicly praise and thank Dr. Michael Livolsi and his entire staff, whom we turned to for a consultation regarding our beloved cat's health condition, which was causing us great concern. We were looking for a cardiologist and an ultrasound specialist, and we turned to him precisely because of the positive reviews.
The positive reviews about his work are true. From the very first moment, we found a warm welcome and helpfulness from the entire staff, and Dr. Livolsi demonstrated great professionalism, along with a truly empathetic and patient approach to our four-legged friend. He also demonstrated great availability and clarity in explaining the diagnosis.
It's worth noting that in just an hour and a half in his office, we received clear answers that we hadn't been able to obtain elsewhere, which would have resulted in wasted time and stress for our cat.
We conclude with a special thank you to Dr. Vittoria, Elisa, and the rest of the staff.

Marcella Roberto and our furry friends.
Experienced, welcoming, and very empathetic team. The only veterinary clinic where dogs are happy when they come in. They're providing excellent care for my puppy, with true passion and dedication.

Expertise, professionalism, and above all, patience are the hallmarks of this practice. The visits and care given to my dog ​​were extremely thorough and meticulous; they treat our four-legged friends as if they were their own. I want to thank the entire team for the care they gave my furry friend, for the warm welcome I received, and for answering all my questions clearly and thoroughly.
The information experience was not as professional as expected and there was little kindness.
We're happy to read this feedback. Thank you.
The staff were friendly, helpful, and very knowledgeable. I sincerely thank them for their hospitality.

I've been coming to this veterinary clinic for years and can honestly say I'm very happy with it. All the staff are always kind, helpful, and very professional. The office is always clean and organized, and you can immediately sense the attention and care they give to the animals.
I have a dog named Golie, and every time I bring him here, I know he's in safe hands. They're all very sweet with animals, treating them with great sensitivity and respect, which is truly important to us owners.
A special thanks goes to Dr. Sara, who is always attentive, competent, and very caring. You can tell she truly loves her job and the animals.
I recommend this clinic to anyone looking for professionalism, compassion, and excellent care for their four-legged friends.

Fake animal lovers... very expensive for the love of animals... the doctor even calls herself the "puppy aunt." With unfriendly manners and threatening looks, they extort money from those who truly love animals.

I was in this veterinary facility for the first time, I was very happy, I found Dr. Silvia who was impeccable in the way she examined my cat, very scrupulous in the complete examination both in ultrasound and in X-rays, very empathetic with animals, no less the girls of the staff, friendly and kind, everyone is good, I recommend it.

Hello, we wanted to publicly thank Dr. Livolsi, an excellence, an angel, who operated on our Theo Wilson, our dachshund with a sweet, loving and tender heart, congratulations. And no less than thanks goes to the staff, kind, thoughtful and prepared doctors! Thank you so much from the bottom of our hearts from Lina and Roberto

Competent and empathetic doctors
I couldn't trust a different practice!

Very professional, kind, and competent staff, very patient with animals. I highly recommend them.
Candidi Massimiliano
Super helpful and professional. You can tell they love their work and the animals. Highly recommended.
Thank you so much for your review and support!

A clinic that combines professionalism and a big heart, passionately dedicated to even stray cats.
I truly appreciate the clinic's commitment to treating all animals with respect and care, regardless of their origin, and this makes it a key point of reference in the Settecamini area. I highly recommend this clinic to anyone seeking quality veterinary care, empathy, and dedication to all animals, including the most fragile and less fortunate.
Thanks to all the staff at this clinic, and especially to the "Aunts" Vittoria, Laura, and Fabiana 💝
Warm, helpful, professional, and highly competent people. Special thanks to my trusted veterinarian Vittoria and Dr. Michael. Thank you for everything you do for our beloved four-legged friends.
Competent and highly empathetic professionals, the doctor performed a thorough and careful examination

I've known Michael for almost twenty years, and I entrust the health of my dogs and cats to him and his staff (Vittoria first and foremost). If I reach all the way from Montesacro to Settecamini, there must be a reason...🥰 …
The doctors are helpful, patient, and competent. A guarantee for us and our furry friends.

I've been coming to this veterinary practice for over ten years and can honestly say it's truly excellent.
Dr. Michael Livolsi is an extraordinary doctor: empathetic, attentive, meticulous, and always there for both his patients and their owners. He exudes trust, calm, and a genuine passion for his work.
Dr. Vittoria Autilitano has always been at his side, a fundamental presence capable of combining professionalism and rare sensitivity. Her attention, care, and the care she devotes to each individual case are truly extraordinary.
I am deeply grateful to have discovered this practice and wouldn't trade it for anything in the world.
I wholeheartedly recommend it to anyone seeking not only expertise but also humanity and true dedication.
A special thanks also to all the medical staff, always kind, helpful, and professional, capable of making you feel welcomed and reassured in every situation. Thank you so much!
Thanks for the nice review, Carola. Milo is always welcome here! See you soon!
Thank you so much for your feedback!

I brought my little dog with a heat stroke and he was breathing badly, I think he needed oxygen and they didn't, after 4 hours I went to pick him up he was worse than before, after checking his heart, they did x-rays and an echocardiogram everything was fine and they insisted that the dog has a tracheal disease instead if there is someone sick it is their mental one I took him to the CVS clinic after half an hour of oxygen and an injection the dog recovered I understood a recently graduated vet incompetent

Following an ultrasound that revealed bladder stones, my family and I decided to have my dog ​​(Leo), a six-year-old Chihuahua, undergo a cystotomy with Dr. Michael and his team.

I won't deny that before the surgery, I was very anxious about him. I felt guilty. The thought of having him undergo surgery when he was still well was exhausting. But the situation could change and become urgent at any moment, causing a urethral obstruction.

Well, what can I say...

The doctors were simply fantastic, helpful, and kind. The day after the surgery, Leo was back to his old self.

A heartfelt thank you to everyone: Elisa, Sara, Vittoria, and Michael, for making one of the few loving and sincere friends I have feel better again.

Fabio

I would like to share my immense joy with you all. This is not the first time I have turned to Dr. Michael Livolsi and his staff; I have several furry friends. This time it was an even stronger experience... I brought my cat who was more on the other side than on this side... I don't think I've ever encountered such a combination of qualities as in this office. Starting from the great professionalism, skill, availability, feedback, kindness and arriving at humanity, and yes, profound humanity. They managed to work a miracle, my cat is still here with me. Amazing! I wholeheartedly recommend this office if you need help ❤
